about: The Fractured Archive's lobby in front of the Archive Door, 99 in every combat skill, ranged worn and a hybrid inventory for the whole raid, on the standard spellbook.
notes: Testing only, not live content: the raid playtest NPC (RaidTester.kt) starts it, as ::scenario does. The loadout is ours, a guess at a strong all-styles raid setup, as the Wiki's raid page asks for melee, ranged and magic (read 2026-11-16): Masori (f) and a Twisted bow worn; a Ghrazi rapier, an Avernic defender and a Kodai wand to switch to, a Dragon warhammer for its special attack, runes for Wind surge (Ezekiel's swords are weak to air) and Fire surge (the Archive Guardian to fire) on the standard spellbook (varbit 4070, spellbook, set to 0), 4 Saradomin brews, 4 Super restores, a Super combat, a Ranging and a Magic potion, and Manta rays, leaving one slot free so a two-handed weapon can be wielded over a weapon and shield. Dragon arrows are worn in every loadout so the Twisted bow can be switched to. Items by gameval name, which the cache audit (ScenarioCacheAuditTest) checks.
